changes: Global Search is now a real switch in Settings, off by default: off, search stays inside the chats you chose, and a notice offers Choose chats or turning it on
Live streams show again under J MOVIES in the Chats list, and a new Live Guide page holds every stream as a wide card with its own name
Home has the Netflix colours: true black and red, and tapping Home again now truly refreshes it
Choose which channels feed the Movies shelves and which feed the Shows shelves, in Settings, Home
The Profile page opens with Netflix style profile tiles: tap to switch, with a daily viewing limit you can set per profile
Cam copies now hide everywhere, the whole family: PreDVD, DVDcam, DVDScr, HDTS, HDTC and HDcam, and a title with only cam copies no longer appears
Subtitle and Audio panels rebuilt in the MX shape, and two subtitles now work by tapping a second track in the one list
MSone subtitle downloads fixed with an in-app browser pass, and subtitle search now matches by name and year
The next episode now starts inside the player itself, never through a loading screen
The best copy is badged in the Copies list, in the one order everywhere: picture first, then the better codec, then the largest file
